Center Airbag Sensor (Computer)
The center airbag sensor (computer) consists of a G sensor, an ignition determination circuit, a backup power source, etc.
Based on the signals from the front airbag sensors and G sensor, it determines ignition of the driver and front passenger SRS airbags, driver SRS knee airbag and pretensioners, and based on the signals from the side airbag sensors and rear side airbag sensors, it determines ignition of the SRS side airbags and SRS curtain shield airbags. In addition, it has a diagnosis function and performs self-diagnosis when a system malfunction occurs.
Components List
Components Function
G Sensor When deceleration is applied by an impact, it outputs a signal that is linear with respect to the deceleration.
Backup Power Source Consists of a backup capacitor that supplies power to the system in a collision or if the power supply system fails, and a booster circuit that raises the voltage.
Computer (Ignition Determination Circuit) Performs specified calculations based on the signal from the front airbag sensors, and sends an ignition signal when the calculated value exceeds a preset value. In addition, the malfunction diagnosis circuit diagnoses whether there is a malfunction in the entire system and informs the driver of any system malfunction, and the diagnosis function diagnoses the location of the system malfunction.
